A Birthday Letter

for

You came back to read it again. I'm smiling.

Dear ,

Happy birthday.

I tried to write you something poetic. Then something perfect. In the end, all I had was something true.

Words were never my strong side. So I did what I could and built you this, every line typed while thinking of you.

You make ordinary days feel like they matter, and hard days feel lighter with your love.

I even drew you something. I'm not an artist, so be kind. And because I know what makes your heart race (besides me, I hope): two wheels and an open road.

Martha, on two wheels.

I can't send you real flowers through a screen. So I grew you some. Pick them.

Tap a flower

Now, before I say the rest: make a wish.

Make a wish. Then blow on your phone, or tap the flame.

I hope you wished for something big. I'll spend my life helping it come true.

There's something I can't put into words, though. So hold the heart.

Press and hold the heart

That's what you do to me.

Thank you for being you, and for choosing me.

I love you, . Today, tomorrow, and for as long as I'm allowed.

Happy birthday darling may your wishes come true and may you live to blow a thousand candles.

Yours,

♥

P.S. If your phone buzzed a little, that was me.

P.P.S. I hid one more thing on this page. Hint: somebody's fuel tank is carrying a heart.
